remarks: CAPTIVATING is the only word that describes this meticulously maintained, highly desired, expansive home w/rooms that could be used as additional bedrooms. The moment you step into the 2-story foyer, you embrace beautifully finished hardwood floors throughout. Prepare to experience the upper level featuring an open floor plan w/LR, formal DR and vaulted ceilings that lead to an elegant, sun filled great room w/large windows & built-ins behind French doors. The gourmet eat-in kitchen w/high-end finished cabinetry, Subzero refrigerator, sleek granite countertop, center island, double ovens, warming drawer and wine refrigerator will prove to be ideal to cook & entertain for any occasion. Down the private hall awaits a grand primary suite equipped with a secluded office/nursery, walk-in closet that boasts a custom wardrobe, and a full bath that warms your body w/heated floors & towel rack, oversized shower and private toilet. The impressive lower level includes 2 large BR's, 3rd full bath, rec room w/fireplace & built-ins, additional office/game space, laundry room, 2 custom cedar closets for fine garments, a large linen closet & 2 car garage w/epoxy floors that will fit an oversized SUV or truck. Outside awaits enjoyment in any season on the extended 600(+/-) sq ft IPE Brazilian hardwood deck w/shaded brick patio underneath. Feel safe year-round knowing you have two 100-amp breakers & Generac generator. This is a rare opportunity to own an immaculate home.
